label: Heat supply
description: Separable systems that raise steam, hot water, thermal oil or hot gas for a process: boilers, CHP, heat pumps, electric and solar heat, fired heaters. The temperature band an archetype reaches is its heat-tier.

label: On-site power generation
description: Electricity-only generation at an industrial site.

label: Machine drive
description: Motors, drives and the systems they turn: pumps, fans and blowers, compressed air, materials handling and processing.

label: Space conditioning
description: Space heating, cooling and ventilation of industrial buildings.

label: Lighting
description: Industrial lighting.

label: Mobile equipment
description: Off-road vehicles and mobile machinery at a site.

label: CO2 capture
description: Capture plants on concentrated or dilute streams, and direct air capture. The stream is the hierarchy node an archetype serves.

label: Iron and steel
description: Coke making, ironmaking, steelmaking, casting and rolling. Excludes downstream fabrication.

label: Cement and lime
description: Clinker production, grinding and blending, cement binders, and lime and dolime calcination. Split from the other mineral products because the kiln dominates.
note: Renamed from cement 2026-11-04 (Brad): lime kilns moved in from non-metallic-minerals.

label: Glass and ceramics
description: Glass melting, forming and finishing; ceramic, brick and tile firing and drying; gypsum calcining; expanded clay aggregate and mineral wool.
note: Renamed from non-metallic-minerals 2026-11-04 (Brad): lime kilns moved to cement-and-lime.

label: Chemicals
description: Petrochemicals, industrial gases, ammonia and fertilizer, and other bulk and fine chemicals.

label: Biofuels
description: Ethanol, biodiesel, renewable diesel and SAF, and renewable natural gas production.

label: Hydrogen
description: Centralized hydrogen production and its distribution by pipeline to industrial users. On-site hydrogen stays in the sector that makes it.

label: Petroleum refining
description: Crude distillation, conversion, treating and utilities at refineries.

label: Pulp and paper
description: Pulping, papermaking, drying and converting.

label: Mining (including coal mining)
description: Metal, non-metal and coal mining, milling and on-site processing. Excludes oil and gas extraction.

label: Oil and gas
description: Extraction, oil sands, gas processing and LNG, and oil and gas pipelines.

label: Food and beverage
description: Food processing, beverage production and tobacco.

label: Non-ferrous metals
description: Primary and secondary aluminum, copper, zinc, nickel and other non-ferrous smelting and refining.

label: Waste treatment
description: Municipal and commercial solid waste treated with energy recovery (waste-to-energy incineration), per t of waste treated; heat and electricity are its secondary products. Landfill gas control, the CIMS waste sector, is not carried.
note: Brad 2026-11-10: the incinerator moved out of heat supply; its service is the waste it treats.

label: Other industry
description: Manufacturing not covered by another sector: machinery, vehicles, textiles, wood products, construction.
